Tipping point forecasting in nonstationary dynamics on function spaces
summary_zh: 本文研究非平稳动力系统中的转折点预测。采用循环神经网络操作符（RNO）学习函数空间之间的映射。通过监测物理约束的偏差来预测转折点。
summary_en: This paper studies the forecasting of tipping points in nonstationary dynamical systems. It employs a recurrent neural operator (RNO) to learn mappings between function spaces and predicts tipping points by monitoring deviations from physical constraints.
insights: 创新点：提出基于RNO的转折点预测方法
方法亮点：采用符合预测框架监测物理约束
关键发现：预测方法在非平稳动力系统中有效
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a tipping point prediction method based on RNO
Method highlight: Uses a conformal prediction framework to monitor physical constraints
Key finding: The prediction method is effective in nonstationary dynamical systems
abstract: Tipping points are abrupt, drastic, and often irreversible changes in the evolution of nonstationary and chaotic dynamical systems. For instance, increased greenhouse gas concentrations are predicted to lead to drastic decreases in low cloud cover, referred to as a climatological tipping point. In this paper, we learn the evolution of such nonstationary dynamical systems using a recurrent neural operator (RNO), which learns mappings between function spaces. After training RNO on only the pre-tipping dynamics, we employ it to detect future tipping points using an uncertainty-based approach. In particular, we propose a conformal prediction framework to forecast tipping points by monitoring deviations from physics constraints (such as conserved quantities and partial differential equations), enabling forecasting of these abrupt changes along with a rigorous measure of uncertainty. We illustrate our proposed methodology on nonstationary ordinary and partial differential equations, such as the Lorenz-63 and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equations. We also apply our methods to forecast a climate tipping point in stratocumulus cloud cover and airfoil wake and stall transitions using only limited knowledge of the governing equations. For the latter, we show that our proposed method zero-shot generalizes to forecasting multiple future tipping points under varying Reynolds numbers. In our experiments, we demonstrate that even partial or approximate physics constraints can be used to accurately forecast future tipping points.

Australia’s current wildfire crisis linked to colonial land-use change
summary_zh: 研究将澳大利亚当前的野火危机与殖民时期的土地利用变化联系起来。实验表明，殖民干扰导致植被结构和燃料动态发生级联变化。
summary_en: This study links Australia's current wildfire crisis to colonial land-use changes. Experiments show cascading changes in vegetation structure and fuel dynamics due to colonial disruption.
insights: 创新点：将野火危机与殖民土地利用变化联系起来
方法亮点：重建东南澳大利亚温带桉树林1000年的植被和火灾变化
关键发现：殖民干扰导致植被结构和燃料动态变化
insights_en: Novelty: Linking the wildfire crisis to colonial land-use changes
Method highlight: Reconstruction of 1000 years of vegetation and fire changes in a southeastern Australian temperate eucalypt forest
Key finding: Cascading changes in vegetation structure and fuel dynamics due to colonial disruption
abstract: is often attributed to climate change, a framing that overlooks crucial historical drivers. Biomes at the forefront of this crisis, such as the temperate eucalypt forests of Australia, have seen alarming increases in large, intense wildfires in recent decades. Yet evidence of how colonial land-use change and the disruption of Indigenous fire use altered vegetation structure and fuel dynamics remains scarce. Here we reconstruct 1,000 years of vegetation and fire change in a temperate eucalypt forest in southeastern Australia. Before the British invasion (from 1788 CE), fire use by the Indigenous Gunaikurnai people maintained stable, open woodlands through frequent, fine-grained, low-temperature cultural burning. Colonial disruption drove cascading changes: increased fire temperature, a fourfold rise in eucalypt cover, a shift from open woodland to forest and increased soil erosion. These transformations preceded anthropogenic warming, indicating that the vulnerability of these forests to wildfire is shaped by colonial land-use legacies. By creating more flammable landscapes, colonial land use amplified the influence of climate change, suggesting a reinforcing feedback (the 'catastrophic wildfire loop') in which high-intensity wildfires raise fuel loads and further increase the likelihood of climate-driven fire. Integrating Indigenous knowledge into fire management is therefore essential to restoring resilience and mitigating future wildfire risk.

title: Closed-loop photoreactor design enabled by machine learning and digital twins
summary_zh: 本文研究高效光反应器设计。方法上结合射线追踪数字孪生和多目标贝叶斯优化。实验表明，模型优化了反射器和试管位置，提高了光子捕获和均匀照射。
summary_en: This paper studies efficient photoreactor design. The method combines ray-tracing digital twins with multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Experiments show the model optimizes reflector shape and vial positioning for enhanced photon capture and uniform irradiation.
insights: 创新点：利用数字孪生优化光反应器设计
方法亮点：多目标贝叶斯优化提高设计效率
关键发现：模型显著提升光子捕获和均匀照射
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizing digital twins for photoreactor design optimization
Method highlight: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization for design efficiency
Key finding: Model significantly improves photon capture and uniform irradiation
abstract: Abstract Designing efficient photoreactors remains challenging due to the complex interplay of reflection, scattering, and absorption. Here, we introduce a closed-loop workflow integrating ray-tracing digital twins with multi-objective Bayesian optimization to design photoreactors with high photon capture and uniform irradiation. A digital 3D reactor model is calibrated using measured emission characteristics, reflectivity data, and geometrical properties and validated against potassium ferrioxalate actinometry. The validated model explores reflector shape and vial positioning, identifying geometries that maximize incident photon flux while maintaining homogeneity across 16 vials. Experimental validation using a photocatalytic Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling shows that reaction yields track simulated photon flux. The optimized reactor is further applied to quantum-yield screening, enabling mechanistic insights across diverse conditions in a single experiment. This work establishes an experimentally validated virtual co-design framework in which machine learning and digital twins accelerate photoreactor development and support quantitative understanding of photochemical processes.

title: Large language models unlock the ecology of species interactions
summary_zh: 利用大型语言模型从公民科学平台中提取生物相互作用数据，研究物种相互作用。
summary_en: Large language models are used to extract species interaction data from citizen science platforms to study species interactions.
insights: 创新点：利用LLM从非结构化数据中提取生物相互作用。
方法亮点：开发LLM工作流程从多语言评论中收集数据。
关键发现：LLM在识别生物相互作用方面有效。
insights_en: Novelty: Using LLM to extract biological interactions from unstructured data.
Method highlight: Developed an LLM workflow to collect data from multilingual comments.
Key finding: LLM is effective in identifying biological interactions.
abstract: Species interactions shape population dynamics, geographic distributions, evolutionary trajectories, and responses to environmental change. Yet data on these interactions remain scarce across broad spatial, temporal, and taxonomic scales because they are difficult to collect in the field. One promising source of interaction data is citizen science platforms, which contain billions of biodiversity observations, often accompanied by unstructured text comments that may document interactions among organisms. Advances in large language models (LLMs) make it increasingly feasible to identify, extract, and categorize biotic interactions from these unstructured data at scale. Here, we present an LLM workflow that collects species interaction observations from multilingual citizen science comments. Using two case studies—bird–bird and plant–pollinator interactions—we show that LLMs can rapidly extract interaction types and participating species with high accuracy. These data can greatly expand the spatial, temporal, and taxonomic coverage and resolution of species interactions data, enable new tests of long-standing ecological questions, and improve our ability to track ecological changes. With appropriate validation, expert review, and attention to data privacy for both users and sensitive species, this approach opens new opportunities to characterize, forecast, and conserve biodiversity under global change.

title: The basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal
summary_zh: 研究显示软球堆积的吸引域并非分形，揭示了标准数值方法在解析能量景观结构时的局限性。
summary_en: Research shows that the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal, revealing the limitations of standard numerical methods in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes.
insights: 创新点：发现软球堆积的吸引域非分形结构。
方法亮点：采用C语言变量系数常微分方程求解器。
关键发现：标准数值方法在解析能量景观结构时存在局限性。
insights_en: Novelty: Found that the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are not fractal in structure.
Method highlight: Using a C-language variable-coefficient ordinary differential equation solver.
Key finding: Standard numerical methods have limitations in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes.
abstract: The energy landscape picture is a central tool to study many-body systems. In particular, the energy landscapes of glass-forming liquids, jammed packings, constraint satisfaction problems, or neural networks contain a plethora of minima corresponding to competing states. Due to their complexity, these landscapes resist analytical treatment and must be studied numerically. We focus on jammed soft spheres, a paradigmatic model of glasses and granulars, to expose the limitations of standard numerical methods in resolving the true structure of energy landscapes. We show that the C-language Variable-coefficients ordinary differential equation solver is the one with the best time-for-error trade-off for this problem, outperforming commonly used steepest-descent solvers by several orders of magnitude. Using this numerical approach, we provide unequivocal evidence that optimizers widely used in computational studies destroy all semblance of the true landscape geometry, even in moderately low dimensions. Employing a range of geometric indicators, both low- and high-dimensional, we show that earlier claims on the fractality of basins of attraction of minima originated from the use of inadequate mapping strategies. In reality, the basins of attraction of soft-sphere packings are smooth structures with well-defined length scales, a result that likely extends to a much broader family of problems.

Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes
summary_zh: 研究提出通过字节化创建字节级大型语言模型的方法，提高对字符敏感数据的处理能力。实验表明字节模型性能接近子词模型。
summary_en: This study introduces a method for creating byte-level large language models through byteification, enhancing the ability to process character-sensitive data. Experiments show that byte models approach the performance of subword models.
insights: 创新点：提出字节化方法创建字节级语言模型
方法亮点：字节模型在字符敏感数据处理上表现优异
关键发现：字节模型性能接近子词模型
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a byteification method to create byte-level language models
Method highlight: Byte models excel in processing character-sensitive data
Key finding: Byte models approach the performance of subword models
abstract: Abstract Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have largely been driven by large language models, deep neural networks that operate over discrete units called tokens. To represent text, most large language models use words or word fragments as the tokens, known as subword tokenization 1 . Subword tokenization obscures fine-grained information, which is problematic, especially for scientific data—such as computer code or biological sequences—where meaning depends on the individual characters or bytes 2 . Models that instead operate directly on the byte encoding of text avoid these limitations, but until now they have lagged behind subword-based models in performance. Here we introduce a general method for creating byte-level large language models through byteification that approach the capabilities of subword-based systems. We use a two-stage conversion procedure to retrofit existing subword-based models into byte-level models with minimal extra training. The resulting models outperform earlier byte-level approaches and excel on character-level reasoning tasks, achieving practical inference speeds by efficiently processing byte-level information and adaptability by reusing the existing ecosystem around the source large language model. Our results remove a long-standing performance barrier to end-to-end byte-level language modelling, demonstrating that models operating on raw text encodings can scale competitively while offering advantages in domains requiring fine-grained textual understanding.

title: Prehistoric global migration of vanishing gut microbes with humans
summary_zh: 研究通过比较玻利维亚蒂斯马内人和坦桑尼亚哈扎人的肠道菌群，揭示人类肠道微生物的史前全球迁移。
summary_en: This study compares the gut microbiomes of the Tsimane horticulturalists of Bolivia and the Hadza hunter-gatherers of Tanzania to reveal the prehistoric global migration of disappearing gut microbes with humans.
insights: 创新点：揭示人类肠道微生物的史前全球迁移
方法亮点：深度宏基因组测序技术
关键发现：微生物多样性变化影响人类健康
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the prehistoric global migration of human gut microbiomes
Method highlight: Deep metagenomic sequencing technology
Key finding: Changes in microbial diversity affect human health
abstract: The gut microbiome is crucial for health and is affected strongly by lifestyle1. Many microorganisms commonly found in non-industrialized populations are disappearing or have become extinct in industrialized populations2–6. Studying which microorganisms have been long-term residents of the human gut and may have co-evolved with humans2,7,8 could provide insights into how microbial biodiversity loss affects human health. However, the genetic complexities of microbial evolution and the plasticity of gut microbiome composition have made it challenging to resolve the evolutionary history of these long-term associations. Here we performed deep metagenomic sequencing of the Tsimane horticulturalists of Bolivia and compared their gut microbiomes with those of the Hadza hunter-gatherers of Tanzania3. These two populations, whose ancestors have been separated for tens of thousands of years, share 1,231 microbial species, most of which are rare in or absent from industrialized populations. Population genetic analyses of 636 of the shared species revealed patterns of microbial divergence and gene flow consistent with prehistoric human co-migration, with estimated split times that approximately align with human migration out of Africa and into the Americas. Our findings indicate that a diverse gut microbiome co-migrated with humans worldwide and has persisted over millennia. However, many of these species are now vanishing from industrialized populations and the consequences for human health remain uncertain. Microbial species disappearing from industrialized populations have evolved with humans over millennia and migrated worldwide with them—this may have consequences for human health.

summary_zh: 本文通过随机对照试验评估教育干预对村庄社会网络结构的影响。方法上采用部分村庄接受干预的设计，以未接受干预的村庄作为对照组。实验表明，干预改变了社会网络结构。
summary_en: This paper evaluates the impact of educational interventions on village social networks through a randomized controlled trial. The method uses a design where a fraction of villages receive the intervention, with non-intervention villages as the control group. Experiments show that the intervention alters social network structures.
insights: 创新点：教育干预可重塑村庄社会网络
方法亮点：随机对照试验评估干预效果
关键发现：干预显著改变社会网络结构
insights_en: Novelty: Educational interventions can rewire village social networks
Method highlight: Randomized controlled trials for intervention evaluation
Key finding: Interventions significantly alter social network structures
abstract: Social networks shape behaviour, affect information dissemination and undergird collective action. And they can be exploited in the design of interventions in these domains1–7. Although social networks obey fundamental principles, such as the degree distribution8,9, they can nevertheless evolve as ties form and break. Here, through a randomized controlled trial involving a total of 8,331 people in 110 remote Honduran villages, we evaluate the secondary effects of a 22-month public-health intervention1 on pre-existing social-network structure. We used a design in which a varying fraction of village households received the intervention, and villages in which no one received the intervention were used as the primary reference group. In ‘low-dosage’ villages (in which 5–30% of households received the intervention), people who received the intervention tended to sever ties with untreated individuals to whom they previously went for health advice. Conversely, in high-dosage villages (50–100%), treated individuals increased their ties. These average changes are explained mainly by tie dynamics; that is, treated–treated pairs persist and form new links, whereas treated–untreated ties dissolve. A mediation analysis indicates that absorption of health information increases the likelihood of tie formation and persistence. The rewiring patterns generally lasted for three years after the intervention ceased. Moreover, although the intervention delivered health information, it reshaped friendship and financial ties, not just health-advice connections. In aggregate, the introduction of a new information regime acted as a kind of social institution, rewiring individuals’ connections even though the overall degree distribution of village-wide networks remained relatively stable. A randomized controlled trial involving a health-education intervention in rural villages in Honduras shows that the intervention changed social network connections, including not only health-related connections but also friendships and financial ties.

title: Early tetrapod neck mobility modelled using an extant analogue
summary_zh: 本文通过现生鲟鱼的轴向柱模型模拟早期四足动物颈部活动。方法上使用材料测试预测四足动物颈部区域的侧弯、伸展和旋转能力。实验表明，模型预测了颈部活动能力。
summary_en: This paper models early tetrapod neck mobility using an extant sturgeon's axial column as an analog. The method uses material tests to predict the capacities of the tetrapod neck region for lateral flexion, extension, and rotation. Experiments show that the model predicts neck mobility capabilities.
insights: 创新点：利用现生鲟鱼模拟早期四足动物颈部活动
方法亮点：材料测试预测颈部活动能力
关键发现：模型预测颈部活动能力
insights_en: Novelty: Using extant sturgeon to model early tetrapod neck mobility
Method highlight: Material testing to predict neck mobility
Key finding: Model predicts neck mobility capabilities
abstract: Abstract Tetrapods arose from lobe-finned fishes with a notochord-dominated axial column 1–3 . During this transition, the skull became separated from the shoulder girdle 4–6 , giving rise to a neck region. This head–shoulder separation has generated hypotheses suggesting that neck mobility increased during the origin of tetrapods, facilitating the ecological transition towards more terrestrial habitats 4,5,7–9 . However, incompletely co-ossified vertebral components 10 have posed a challenge to modelling the mobility of these early tetrapod necks. Here we used material tests on the similarly configured axial columns of sturgeon to predict the capacities of the tetrapod neck region for lateral flexion, extension and rotation across the tetrapod stem. Our model indicates that the soft tissue-dominated axial column was surprisingly rigid, despite lacking co-ossified vertebral components. We estimate that most stem tetrapods could move their heads less than 6° laterally and less than 3° dorsally but could not rotate them. Notably, mobility did not shift in conjunction with the head–shoulder separation that occurred between the origin of tristichopterids (represented by Eusthenopteron ) and that of more crownward stem tetrapods. Therefore, mobility in the tetrapod neck did not serve as a functional driver of head–shoulder separation. Instead, forelimb-driven locomotion, implicated in early tetrapods 11–14 , provides a better functional explanation for the head–shoulder separation.

title: The more you automate, the less you see: Hidden pitfalls of autonomous AI scientists
summary_zh: 本文分析开源AI科学家系统，揭示自动化科学研究的潜在缺陷。发现不当基准选择、数据泄露、指标误用和后验选择偏差等问题。
summary_en: This paper analyzes open-source AI scientist systems, revealing hidden pitfalls of automated scientific research. Issues such as inappropriate benchmark selection, data leakage, metric misuse, and post hoc selection bias are found.
insights: 创新点：揭示自动化科学研究的潜在缺陷
方法亮点：分析开源AI科学家系统
关键发现：发现多种潜在缺陷
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing hidden pitfalls of automated scientific research
Method highlight: Analyzing open-source AI scientist systems
Key finding: Discovering various potential pitfalls
abstract: The rapid rise of autonomous AI scientists marks a paradigm shift in scientific discovery by automating the research lifecycle. Yet their rushed development has outpaced critical oversight, leaving key workflow decisions dangerously unscrutinized. We present a much-needed systematic analysis of open-source AI scientist systems, investigating four primary pitfalls: inappropriate benchmark selection, data leakage, metric misuse, and post hoc selection bias. Through controlled experiments that isolate each pitfall, we find systematic vulnerabilities across two representative open-source systems. Crucially, we find that these flaws are largely invisible at the level of the final manuscript, suggesting that current manuscript-centric peer review paradigms are fundamentally insufficient for ensuring the integrity of automated research. We further propose mitigation strategies and demonstrate that access to full workflow artifacts (log traces and code) enables more effective auditing. Our findings suggest that journals, conferences, and researchers should move beyond manuscript-only evaluation toward process auditing the end-to-end workflow artifacts of AI scientist systems.

title: Data everywhere, but are they fit for purpose?
summary_zh: 大量数据改变生活管理，需建立评估数据适用性的基础设施。
summary_en: Vast amounts of data are reshaping how people manage their lives, requiring infrastructure to assess data suitability.
insights: 创新点：数据在生活中的作用
方法亮点：建立数据适用性评估体系
关键发现：数据基础设施的重要性
insights_en: Novelty: The role of data in daily life
Method highlight: Establishing a data suitability assessment system
Key finding: The importance of data infrastructure
abstract: Vast amounts of new data are fundamentally shaping how people manage their lives and do their work. The volume is overwhelming—Google Dataset Search discovers 2 million new datasets every month—and so are the uses by scientists, governments, and the public. Governments across the world are treating data as a strategic asset. But data alone are not enough. Infrastructure must be developed that can provide signals about which data are “fit for purpose” for the increasingly vast number of potential uses. Informed and appropriate use is, after all, the ultimate objective of making data available for the public good.

title: AI-generated language remains systematically distinguishable from human communication
summary_zh: 研究引入CHAT框架，结合检测性和语义相似性指标，评估LLM生成语言的现实性。
summary_en: This study introduces the CHAT framework, combining detectability and semantic similarity metrics to assess the realism of LLM-generated language.
insights: 创新点：引入CHAT框架评估LLM语言
方法亮点：结合检测性和语义相似性指标
关键发现：LLM语言与人类通信存在系统性差异
insights_en: Novelty: Introduction of the CHAT framework for assessing LLM language
Method highlight: Combination of detectability and semantic similarity metrics
Key finding: Systematic differences between LLM-generated language and human communication
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in the social sciences to simulate human behavior and communication, yet validation methods for these applications remain limited. Existing evaluations often rely on human judgments of plausibility, a coarse, difficult-to-scale, and often unreliable benchmark for distinguishing AI-generated from human text. As a result, researchers lack robust tools for assessing the realism of LLM-generated language and for calibrating models to real-world data. We address this gap in two ways. First, we introduce the Conversational Human Authenticity Test (CHAT), a validation framework that combines aggregate metrics of detectability and semantic similarity with interpretable linguistic features, including stylistic markers and topical patterns, to assess how closely LLMs approximate human language in a given dataset. Second, we benchmark nine open-weight LLMs across five calibration strategies, including fine-tuning, stylistic prompting, and context retrieval, on user interactions from X, Bluesky, and Reddit. We find that even after calibration, LLM outputs remain clearly distinguishable from human text, especially in affective tone and emotional expression. Instruction-tuned models generally underperform base models, and larger models do not obviously improve human-likeness. We also identify a trade-off between realism and semantic fidelity: methods that make outputs seem more human often move them further from the content of human responses. Together, these results provide a scalable framework for validation and calibration in LLM-based social simulation while underscoring current limits in reproducing human communication.

title: Letters and Biological Process: Linguistic Structure Encodes Hierarchical Depth in the Gene Ontology
summary_zh: 本文研究基因本体（GO）生物过程术语命名中的语言结构。方法上，通过语义表示和聚类分析，发现术语命名与GO层次深度相关。实验表明，术语长度与深度成正比。
summary_en: This paper investigates the linguistic structure in the naming of Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process terms. The method uses semantic representations and clustering analysis to find a correlation between term naming and GO hierarchical depth. Experiments show term length correlates with depth.
insights: 创新点：发现术语命名与GO层次深度相关。
方法亮点：结合语义表示和聚类分析，揭示语言结构信息。
关键发现：术语长度与深度成正比。
insights_en: Novelty: Finds a correlation between term naming and GO hierarchical depth.
Method highlight: Combines semantic representations and clustering analysis to reveal linguistic structure information.
Key finding: Term length correlates with depth.
abstract: Abstract Motivation We asked whether the natural language used to name Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process terms encodes hierarchical position in the GO directed acyclic graph. Results Semantic representations of term names, combined with UMAP visualization and k-means clustering (k=20) recovered biologically coherent semantic groups whose depth distributions differed strongly (Kruskal–Wallis H=5244, p<10−300; η2=0.217). Term-name length increased with depth (Pearson r=0.34, Spearman ρ=0.37; slope ≈3.2 letters per level), and this positive scaling held under shortest-, longest-, and average-path depth definitions. Vocabulary entropy followed a bell-shaped diversification–specialization curve with an intermediate-depth peak (maximal at depth 4) that lies outside a Monte Carlo null envelope across most depths, and null-model tests supported a genuine linguistic–hierarchical association. Availability and implementation The go_lingdepth Python package, regenerated result tables, and figure-generation scripts are available at https://github.com/Sadiya-ISU/Letters-and-Biological-Process and archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21501473). Supplementary information Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: CryoTriplane: Triplane-based Neural Radiance Field Representation for High-resolution Cryo-EM 3D Homogeneous Reconstruction
summary_zh: 研究蛋白质三维结构，提出基于三平面神经辐射场的高分辨率冷冻电镜三维同质重建方法，实验结果表明该方法有效提高重建质量。
summary_en: This study investigates protein 3D structure, proposing a triplane-based neural radiance field method for high-resolution cryo-EM 3D homogeneous reconstruction, which effectively improves reconstruction quality in experiments.
insights: 创新点：提出三平面神经辐射场方法
方法亮点：有效提高重建质量
关键发现：实验验证了方法的有效性
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a triplane-based neural radiance field method
Method highlight: Effectively improves reconstruction quality
Key finding: The method has been experimentally validated
abstract: MOTIVATION: Determining the three-dimensional (3D) structure of proteins is a cornerstone of structural biology, providing essential insights into their underlying biological mechanisms and functional roles. Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) single-particle analysis allows researchers to investigate biomolecules at near-atomic resolutions, unraveling the structure of biomolecular complexes. However, reconstructing high-fidelity 3D volumes from extremely noisy projections, particularly under the interference of structural heterogeneity, remains a challenging task. Traditional Fourier-domain methods often suffer from frequency-dependent signal attenuation and uneven information distribution. While recent deep-learning-based frameworks attempt to predict high-frequency components directly in frequency space, they are highly susceptible to noise and often introduce artifacts. State-of-the-art (SOTA) real-space method circumvents Fourier-domain defects, yet remains constrained by the inherent spectral bias of multi-layer perceptrons, as fixed positional encoding fails to sufficiently capture intricate high-frequency details. RESULTS: We propose cryoTriplane, a real-space 3D homogeneous reconstruction network that utilizes a hybrid spatial representation to adaptively capture fine structural details. By combining fixed positional encoding for noise-robust structural initialization with structure-aware positional encoding for high-frequency refinement, our method achieves 3D reconstructions that are simultaneously globally consistent and locally fine-grained. Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations across five simulated and four real-world datasets demonstrate that cryoTriplane significantly outperforms existing methods in resolving fine structural features. Furthermore, validation through downstream atomic modeling underscores cryoTriplane's ability to recover high-quality density maps. Specifically, our method achieves sequence coverage improvements of 4.6% and 5.5% on the EMPIAR-10005 and EMPIAR-10492 datasets over the SOTA approach, respectively. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Our code is available at https://github.com/chengyr1999/CryoTriplane. The real datasets used in this study are publicly available from EMPIAR.

title: Estimating the threat of AI-agent responding across online survey platforms
summary_zh: 研究评估了AI代理在在线调查平台上的威胁。开发了AI检测测试。发现不同平台AI测试失败率差异大。
summary_en: This study assesses the threat of AI agents on online survey platforms. AI detection tests were developed. Found wide variation in failure rates of AI tests across platforms.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种新的AI检测方法。
方法亮点：通过在线平台收集数据，评估AI代理的威胁。
关键发现：未检测到的AI代理可能影响在线调查结果。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a new AI detection method.
Method highlight: Collected data from online platforms to assess the threat of AI agents.
Key finding: Undetected AI agents may impact the results of online surveys.
abstract: Recent research and advances in LLMs have led to widespread concern that AI agents could pose as human online survey-takers. However, it remains unclear how prevalent AI agents are on survey research platforms and how to effectively detect AI agents. We validated a series of AI detection tests that effectively separated verified-human participants from both prompted commercial and purpose-built AI agents. Using these tests, we collected surveys on seven online platforms and find wide variation in rates of respondents failing AI tests, ranging from 6 to 41% across platforms (compared to a 2.4% false-positive rate for in-person human participants). We further demonstrate that undetected AI agents can impact the results of online surveys. Our findings suggest that while there is an urgent need for AI detection tests and consistent, systematic monitoring of data quality on online platforms, some platforms currently appear to provide data with a low rate of AI agents.

title: Efficient and accurate steering of large language models through attention-guided feature learning
summary_zh: 研究引入了注意力引导的激活引导框架，以解决大型语言模型激活引导中的三个核心挑战。
summary_en: The research introduces an attention-guided activation steering framework to overcome three core challenges in large language model activation steering.
insights: 创新点：提出注意力引导的激活引导框架。
方法亮点：解决激活引导中的核心挑战。
关键发现：提高大型语言模型的引导能力。
insights_en: Novelty: An attention-guided activation steering framework is proposed.
Method highlight: Solving core challenges in activation steering.
Key finding: Improving the guiding ability of large language models.
abstract: Activation steering, or direct manipulation of internal activations to guide large language model (LLM) responses toward specific semantic concepts, is emerging as a promising avenue for both understanding how semantic concepts are stored within LLMs and advancing LLM capabilities. Yet, existing steering methods are remarkably brittle, with seemingly nonsteerable concepts becoming completely steerable based on subtle algorithmic choices in how concept-related features are extracted. In this work, we introduce an attention-guided framework for activation steering that overcomes three core challenges associated with steering: 1) automatic selection of relevant token embeddings for extracting concept-related features; 2) accounting for heterogeneity of concept-related features across LLM activations; and 3) identification of layers most relevant for steering. Across a steering benchmark of 512 semantic concepts, our framework substantially improved steering over previous state-of-the-art (nearly doubling the number of successfully steered concepts) across model architectures and sizes (up to 70 billion parameter models). Furthermore, we use our framework to shed light on the distribution of concept-specific features across LLM layers. Overall, our framework opens further avenues for developing efficient, highly scalable fine-tuning algorithms for industry-scale LLMs.

title: AI can persuade people to take political actions
summary_zh: 研究通过对话式AI模型说服参与者采取政治行动，发现AI在行为结果上具有显著的劝说效果。
summary_en: The study used conversational AI models to persuade participants to take political actions, finding significant AI persuasion effects on behavioral outcomes.
insights: 创新点：AI在政治行动上的劝说效果得到证实。
方法亮点：使用对话式AI模型进行实验。
关键发现：AI对行为有显著影响。
insights_en: Novelty: AI's persuasive effects on political actions are confirmed.
Method highlight: Using conversational AI models for experiments.
Key finding: AI has a significant impact on behavior.
abstract: There is substantial concern about the ability of advanced AI to influence people’s behavior. A rapidly growing body of research has found that AI can produce large persuasive effects on people’s attitudes, but whether AI can persuade people to take consequential real-world actions has remained unclear. In two large preregistered experiments ( N = 17 , 950 responses from 14,779 people), we used conversational AI models to persuade participants on a range of attitudinal and behavioral outcomes, including signing real petitions and donating money to charity. We found sizable AI persuasion effects on these behavioral outcomes (e.g. + 19.7 percentage points on petition signing). However, we observed no evidence of a correlation between AI persuasion effects on attitudes and effects on behavior. Moreover, we replicated prior findings that information provision drove effects on attitudes, but found no such evidence for our behavioral outcomes. In a test of eight behavioral persuasion strategies, the strategy focused on information provision produced the smallest behavioral effect, though differences among the eight were small. Taken together, these results suggest that previous findings relying on attitudinal outcomes may generalize poorly to behavior, and therefore risk substantially mischaracterizing the real-world behavioral impact of AI persuasion.

title: Nitrogen deposition does not alter the temperate forest soil carbon pool: A 14-y experiment on varied nitrogen fertilization
summary_zh: 14年实验表明，不同氮肥施用量对温带森林土壤碳库没有显著影响。
summary_en: A 14-year experiment showed that different nitrogen fertilization rates had no significant impact on the temperate forest soil carbon pool.
insights: 创新点：长期实验研究氮肥对土壤碳库的影响。
方法亮点：使用多种氮肥施用量进行实验。
关键发现：氮肥施用量对土壤碳库无显著影响。
insights_en: Novelty: A long-term experiment studies the impact of nitrogen fertilization on soil carbon pools.
Method highlight: Using various nitrogen fertilization rates in the experiment.
Key finding: Nitrogen fertilization rates have no significant impact on soil carbon pools.
abstract: Soil carbon (C) pools in nitrogen-limited temperate forests are critical to the global C cycle, but there are no long-term experiments examining soil C, with various nitrogen (N) forms. Here, a 14-y experiment (100 kg N ha −1 y −1 ), with added N simulating atmospheric deposition proportions (~70% inorganic, ~30% organic) did not affect soil C pools, whereas organic N (ON) and inorganic N (IN) individually significantly increased values by 2.7-fold and 1.8-fold, respectively. Although no treatment significantly affected soil pH, treatment effects on pH were negatively associated with soil C pools. In addition, treatments containing ON forms increased mineral-associated organic C fractions, indicating enhanced C stability vs. IN. These findings enhance our understanding of N deposition-soil C pool interactions.

title: Systemic collapse emergence from climate-induced perturbations in transportation networks
summary_zh: 研究气候扰动对交通网络的影响。构建模型分析系统崩溃机制。发现外部事件对交通系统有显著影响。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of climate-induced perturbations on transportation networks. A model is constructed to analyze the mechanism of systemic collapse. It is found that external events have a significant impact on transportation systems.
insights: 气候事件对基础设施影响显著
模型有效捕捉系统崩溃行为
外部事件对交通系统影响重大
insights_en: Climate events have significant impacts on infrastructure
The model effectively captures systemic collapse behavior
External events have a major impact on transportation systems
abstract: The interaction between human infrastructures and external events results in loss of functionality or even complete system disruption through a snowball effect of cascading failures. Their complex interplay challenges their prevention, affecting the human population that rely on their functionality. Understanding how these networks respond to external perturbations is crucial for predicting and mitigating the impacts of disruptive events. In particular, meteorological events, while not preventable, can have significant impacts on human infrastructure. Here, we propose a model coupling the dynamics of transportation systems to the dynamics of external events considered as fields, to capture at the same time the critical behavior of the former and the level of influence of the latter. The impact of rainfalls on real-world railway networks provides a compelling case study, showcasing local endemic and system-wide disruptions above a critical value of the rainfall strength. Remarkably, localized perturbations on the wider network reveals the local weaknesses of the global infrastructure, and we assess them in terms of system perturbability and corresponding societal risk. Our framework opens the door to the quantitative analysis of criticalities in essential human infrastructure imputable to vulnerabilities that are set to intensify due to climate change.

title: Insights from coproduced scenarios toward urban sustainability transformations
summary_zh: 分析城市可持续发展愿景和路径。通过合作工作坊探索未来城市。发现合作产生多样化愿景。
summary_en: This study analyzes urban sustainability visions and pathways. Through collaborative workshops, future urban scenarios are explored. It is found that coproduction generates diverse visions.
insights: 合作工作坊促进多样化愿景
城市可持续发展需多样化路径
合作产生创新解决方案
insights_en: Collaborative workshops promote diverse visions
Urban sustainability requires diverse pathways
Collaboration generates innovative solutions
abstract: Urban sustainability transformations call for fundamental shifts in how cities are organized, developed, and governed. Yet we need a better understanding of the diversity of visions and pathways that can enable transformative change. We address this gap through an analysis of 60 coproduced positive scenario visions and pathways developed using the Sustainable Future Scenario process, across nine US and Latin American cities participating in the Urban Resilience to Extremes Sustainability Research Network. We engaged diverse urban stakeholders—including government, nonprofit, and private decision-makers, community leaders, residents, and academic collaborators—in more than 20 coproduction workshops to explore alternative urban futures of sustainability and resilience. We examined how the coproduced scenarios represent five domains of transformative change (nature–human relationships, economic transformation, governance, social and environmental justice, and infrastructure futures) and four theories of transformative change (structural/institutional, agency/power, goals of the system, and worldviews/values). Most pathways combined multiple theories of change operating across multiple domains, revealing urban transformations as entangled rather than singular interventions. Some strategies were common across cities—car-free regions, decentralized infrastructure, community-based governance, expanded fundamental rights—yet were pursued with different transformative aims, demonstrating how a strategy’s transformative intent depends on the theories of change behind it. These findings position coproduced scenarios as more than a normative or planning tool and offer an analytical approach for surfacing the possibility space of urban transformation.

title: Gaussian-LIC2: LiDAR-Inertial-Camera Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary_zh: 提出基于高斯散布的SLAM系统，解决视觉质量、几何精度和实时性能问题。采用连续时间轨迹优化框架进行位姿估计，实时重建大规模3D高斯地图。利用零样本深度模型生成密集深度图，提高重建质量。
summary_en: Introduces a photo-realistic LiDAR-Inertial-Camera Gaussian Splatting SLAM system addressing visual quality, geometric accuracy, and real-time performance. Performs pose estimation within a continuous-time trajectory optimization framework and reconstructs a large-scale 3D Gaussian map in real time. Utilizes a lightweight zero-shot depth model to generate dense depth maps for improved reconstruction.
insights: 创新点：提出基于高斯散布的SLAM系统
方法亮点：采用连续时间轨迹优化框架进行位姿估计
关键发现：零样本深度模型提高重建质量
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed Gaussian Splatting SLAM system
Method highlight: Pose estimation within a continuous-time trajectory optimization framework
Key finding: Zero-shot depth model improves reconstruction quality
abstract: This paper presents a photo-realistic LiDAR-Inertial-Camera Gaussian Splatting SLAM system that simultaneously addresses visual quality, geometric accuracy, and real-time performance. The proposed method performs robust and accurate pose estimation within a continuous-time trajectory optimization framework, while incrementally reconstructing a large-scale 3D Gaussian map using camera and LiDAR data, all in real time. The resulting map enables high-quality, real-time novel view rendering of both RGB images and depth maps. To effectively address under-reconstruction in regions not covered by the LiDAR, we employ a lightweight zero-shot depth model that synergistically combines RGB appearance cues with sparse LiDAR measurements to generate dense depth maps. The depth completion enables reliable Gaussian initialization in LiDAR-blind areas, significantly improving system applicability for sparse LiDAR sensors. To enhance geometric accuracy, we fully use sparse but precise LiDAR depths to supervise Gaussian map optimization and accelerate it with carefully designed CUDA-accelerated strategies. Furthermore, we explore how the incrementally reconstructed Gaussian map can improve the robustness of the odometry. By efficiently incorporating photometric constraints from the Gaussian map into the continuous-time factor graph optimization, we demonstrate improved tracking performance, especially under LiDAR degenerated scenarios. We also showcase downstream applications via extending our elaborate system, including video frame interpolation and fast 3D mesh production. To support rigorous evaluation, we collect a dedicated LiDAR-Inertial-Camera dataset featuring ground-truth poses, depth maps, and extrapolated trajectories for assessing out-of-sequence novel view synthesis in large-scale outdoor scenarios. Extensive experiments on both public and self-collected datasets demonstrate the superiority and versatility of our system across LiDAR sensors with varying sampling densities.

title: Fast Feature Field (F 3 ): A general predictive representation of events for robot perception
summary_zh: 开发基于事件相机的Fast Feature Field (F 3 )，通过预测未来事件来学习场景结构和运动信息。F 3 利用事件数据的稀疏性，并高效计算，适用于多种下游任务。
summary_en: Develops Fast Feature Field (F 3 ) for event-based cameras, learning scene structure and motion information by predicting future events. F 3 exploits the sparsity of event data and computes efficiently, suitable for a range of downstream tasks.
insights: 创新点：开发基于事件相机的Fast Feature Field (F 3 )
方法亮点：利用事件数据的稀疏性
关键发现：适用于多种下游任务
insights_en: Novelty: Developed Fast Feature Field (F 3 ) for event-based cameras
Method highlight: Exploits the sparsity of event data
Key finding: Suitable for a range of downstream tasks
abstract: This paper develops a mathematical argument and algorithms for building representations of data from event-based cameras that we call Fast Feature Field (F 3 ). We learned this representation by predicting future events from past events and show that it preserves scene structure and motion information. F 3 exploits the sparsity of event data and is robust to noise and variations in event rates. It can be computed efficiently using ideas from multiresolution hash encoding and deep sets, achieving 120 hertz at high-definition (HD) resolution and 440 hertz at video graphics array (VGA) resolution. F 3 represents events in a contiguous spatiotemporal volume as a multichannel image, enabling a range of downstream tasks. We obtained state-of-the-art performance on optical flow estimation, semantic segmentation, and monocular metric depth estimation, on data from three robotic platforms (a car, a quadruped robot, and a flying platform) and across different lighting conditions (daytime and nighttime), environments (indoors, outdoors, urban, and off-road), and dynamic vision sensors (resolutions and event rates). Our implementations can predict these tasks at 25 to 75 hertz at HD resolution.

A generative diffusion framework for physically consistent 3D turbulence
summary_zh: 提出物理约束扩散模型，直接将先验约束纳入生成动力学。以旋转湍流为例，展示其稳定且统计上忠实于惯性范围的3D湍流合成。
summary_en: Proposed a physics-constrained diffusion model where some a priori constraints can be directly incorporated into the generative dynamics. Demonstrated its stable and statistically faithful synthesis of three-dimensional turbulence in the inertial range using rotating turbulence as an example.
insights: 创新点：物理约束扩散模型，提高湍流合成质量
方法亮点：直接将先验约束纳入生成动力学
关键发现：旋转湍流合成稳定且忠实
insights_en: Novelty: Physics-constrained diffusion model, improves quality of turbulence synthesis
Method highlight: Directly incorporates a priori constraints into generative dynamics
Key finding: Rotating turbulence synthesis is stable and statistically faithful
abstract: Abstract Synthesizing fully developed three-dimensional turbulence remains a long-standing problem in fluid mechanics and an open challenge for generative modeling. This difficulty arises from extreme dimensionality, multiscale fluctuations, strong intermittency, and the need to satisfy exact physical constraints, including incompressibility and prescribed mass and momentum fluxes under given boundary conditions. We propose a physics-constrained diffusion model in which some a priori constraints can be incorporated directly into the generative dynamics. Using rotating turbulence as a paradigmatic system with key geophysical applications, we assess the proposed framework. Here, we show that it enables stable and statistically faithful single-time synthesis of inertial-range three-dimensional turbulent velocity fields, accurately reproducing anisotropic energy spectra, intermittent statistics, and physical constraints, whereas standard denoising diffusion probabilistic models exhibit multiscale statistical deviations, violations of physical consistency, and substantially slower training convergence, thereby pointing to broader implications for generative modeling of high-dimensional, physically constrained complex systems.

Reward function compression facilitates goal-dependent reinforcement learning
summary_zh: 研究提出目标依赖性学习初期依赖工作记忆。通过经验积累，学习者创建压缩奖励函数。
summary_en: This study proposes that goal-dependent learning initially relies on capacity-limited working memory, and learners create a compressed reward function through consistent experience.
insights: 创新点：压缩奖励函数在目标依赖性学习中的作用
方法亮点：通过实验验证学习效率的提升
关键发现：奖励处理速度与学习效率相关
insights_en: Novelty: The role of reward function compression in goal-dependent learning
Method highlight: Experimental validation of improved learning efficiency
Key finding: Correlation between reward processing speed and learning efficiency
abstract: Abstract Humans can uniquely assign value to novel, abstract outcomes to support reinforcement learning. However, this flexibility is cognitively costly and reduces learning efficiency. We propose that goal-dependent learning initially relies on capacity-limited working memory. With consistent experience, learners create a compressed reward function — a simplified rule — that transfers to long-term memory for automatic evaluation upon receiving feedback. This automaticity frees working memory resources, thereby boosting learning efficiency. Across six experiments, we demonstrate that learning is impaired by the size of the goal space but improves when this space allows for compression. Additionally, faster reward processing correlates with better learning. Although the algorithmic details remain to be established, computational modeling revealed that individual differences in compression efficiency, proxied by reward processing speed, led to higher choice accuracy. Together, our behavioral results and computational models suggest that efficient goal-directed learning relies on compressing complex goals into stable reward functions.

title: Generative diffusion surrogates with analytical variance schedule
summary_zh: 研究提出具有分析方差计划的生成扩散代理。方法上，通过分析方差来指导噪声调度。实验表明，这种方法能够代表非高斯分布结构。
summary_en: This study proposes generative diffusion surrogates with an analytical variance schedule. The method involves guiding noise scheduling through analytical variance. Experiments show that this method can represent non-Gaussian distributional structure.
insights: 创新点：分析方差指导噪声调度

insights_en: Novelty: Analytical variance guiding noise scheduling
Method highlight: Representation of non-Gaussian distributional structure
Key finding: Applicable to physical systems
abstract: Abstract Stochastic transport describes physical systems in which an initially structured distribution spreads under unresolved forcing, scattering, or heterogeneous media. Useful surrogates for such systems should be probabilistic, time-resolved, and able to represent non-Gaussian distributional structure. Generative diffusion models, which corrupt data with Gaussian noise and learn a reverse flow back to structured states, have these properties. Their noise schedules, however, are usually chosen heuristically: image and audio generation—the canonical use cases—provide no physical clock. In transport, by contrast, the variance, or mean-square displacement, is often known from macroscopic theory or empirical scaling even when the full distribution is not. Here we prescribe the forward noising rate as the time derivative of this variance, turning generative time into a calibrated transport clock. The variance path is enforced by construction, while the learned score field represents how non-Gaussian structure inherited from entrance data is smoothed along that path, requiring no intermediate-time physical transport data. For ballistic-to-diffusive transport in turbulent plasmas, the surrogate matches test-particle distributions, reproduces the laboratory-measured variance scale, and tracks the simulated kurtosis evolution without schedule tuning, enabling calibrated emulation and likelihood-based inference.

abstract: Lightweight large language models hold promise for scientific applications but remain limited in rule-constrained domains because they can reproduce linguistic patterns without following scientific principles, leading to hallucinations. Here, we show that G-Frame, an adaptive multi-agent framework inspired by Bayesian game and team game principles, enables a closed-loop process for automated data generation, model evaluation, and training. By assigning complementary roles to multiple agents, G-Frame generates structured reasoning data and constructs a specialized corpus containing 363,045 chain-of-thought examples and 199,589 question–answer pairs. Using this corpus together with domain pre-training and adaptive training, the 7-billion-parameter model OmniChem achieves competitive performance across the reported benchmarks and reduces the ChemJudge hallucination rate from 41.95% for the base model to 12.91%. Case studies further illustrate potential applications in molecular design and selected synthesis-planning tasks. These results support G-Frame as an extensible game theory-driven multi-agent framework for improving the reliability of lightweight scientific language models. Lightweight AI models can be unreliable in specialized scientific tasks. Here, the authors introduce G-Frame, which uses game theory to coordinate multiple AI agents, automate data generation and training, and reduce hallucinations.

Method highlight: Uses distributed fiber optic sensors.

abstract: Abstract The safety assessment of battery systems is constrained by sparse temperature measurements and monolithic diagnostic frameworks in conventional battery management systems (BMS). To address this, we propose a multi-model collaborative thermal-runaway early-warning framework using distributed temperature sensing. An integrated sensing scheme increases temperature sensing points within the battery pack from 32 to 540 with minimal wiring complexity and is validated in real-world vehicle operation. We establish a functional relationship between temperature Shannon entropy (SE) and average temperature variation to derive a dynamic warning boundary incorporating error tolerance. Integrating this boundary with thresholds for temperature, temperature change rate, and SE change rate enables collaborative early warning. Compared with conventional BMS warning benchmarks, the framework provides maximum warning lead times of 706 s in laboratory modules and 554 s in real-world vehicle operation. These findings demonstrate the potential of distributed sensing and collaborative diagnostics for proactive thermal-runaway risk identification.

title: Fluorescence-illuminated diffraction tomography using explicit neural fields
summary_zh: 本文提出荧光照明衍射断层扫描技术，重建无标记和荧光标记物体的三维折射率。方法上，通过反射模式获取衍射荧光图像。实验表明，该技术可应用于厚组织及体内应用。
summary_en: This paper introduces fluorescence-illuminated diffraction tomography for reconstructing 3D refractive index of label-free and fluorescence-labeled objects. The method acquires diffraction fluorescence images in reflection mode. Experiments show its applicability in thick tissues and in vivo applications.
insights: 创新点：提出荧光照明衍射断层扫描技术
方法亮点：在反射模式下重建折射率
关键发现：技术适用于厚组织和体内应用
insights_en: Novelty: Introduces fluorescence-illuminated diffraction tomography
Method highlight: Reconstructs refractive index in reflection mode
Key finding: Applicable to thick tissues and in vivo applications
abstract: Abstract Multimodal fluorescence and phase imaging provides complementary information about biological samples. However, existing simultaneous fluorescence-phase techniques primarily operate in transmission mode and are limited to thin specimens, restricting their use in thick tissues and in vivo applications. Although multiphoton microscopy enables deep-tissue fluorescence imaging, combining it with three-dimensional refractive-index (RI) imaging remains challenging because few methods can reconstruct the RI of bulky, label-free tissues in reflection mode at subcellular resolution. Here, we introduce fluorescence-illuminated diffraction tomography (FDT), which reconstructs the 3D RI of label-free and fluorescence-labeled objects from diffracted fluorescence images acquired in reflection mode under two-photon excitation. FDT uses the transport of intensity equation and a self-supervised neural network based on explicit neural fields. Compared with state-of-the-art implicit neural fields, this approach improves computational speed, reconstruction accuracy, and interpretability. We demonstrate FDT in two experimental regimes: reconstructing the 3D RI of label-free tissues up to 300 μ m thick placed on a fluorescent substrate, and reconstructing the 3D RI of fluorescence-labeled, 3D-cultured cells without transmission-side access using fluorescence emitted by the cells themselves. FDT establishes a foundation for accessible reflection-mode multimodal fluorescence-phase imaging in complex biological systems.

title: Large-scale identical-location electron microscopy enables quantifying nanoparticulate electrocatalyst degradation
summary_zh: 本文通过扩大相同位置的扫描透射电子显微镜，追踪碳载铂钴纳米粒子的结构演变。方法上，重复成像相同的纳米粒子。实验表明，技术可量化纳米电催化剂的降解。
summary_en: This paper uses scaled-up identical-location scanning transmission electron microscopy to track the structural evolution of carbon-supported platinum-cobalt nanoparticles. The method repeatedly images the same nanoparticles. Experiments show the technique can quantify nanoparticulate electrocatalyst degradation.
insights: 创新点：扩大相同位置的扫描透射电子显微镜
方法亮点：重复成像相同的纳米粒子
关键发现：量化纳米电催化剂的降解
insights_en: Novelty: Scales up identical-location scanning transmission electron microscopy
Method highlight: Repeated imaging of the same nanoparticles
Key finding: Quantifies nanoparticulate electrocatalyst degradation
abstract: Abstract Fuel cells convert chemical energy into electricity, and their performance relies on electrocatalysts whose durability during operation remains poorly understood. Deep mechanistic insight into electrocatalyst stability is essential to design durable, resource-efficient fuel cells. Nanoparticulate electrocatalysts degrade via diverse nanoscale processes, yet particle-to-particle heterogeneity in structure, support interaction, and local microenvironment make true particle-level quantification and understanding impossible with classical approaches. Here we scale up identical-location scanning transmission electron microscopy, which repeatedly images the very same nanoparticles, to track the structural evolution of hundreds of carbon-supported platinum-cobalt nanoparticles, a prototypical oxygen reduction reaction electrocatalyst. We present a three-step image analysis workflow comprising segmentation, tracking, and degradation-event classification with progressive automation, including machine-learning-assisted detection of overlapping particles. By pairing nanoscale resolution and local history with population-level statistics, the pipeline enables unbiased identification and quantification of degradation pathways across statistically meaningful particle sets. We reveal particle size- and shape-dependent effects, showing that smaller and irregular nanoparticles are more prone to detachment, and provide a data-driven framework for probing electrocatalyst degradation at scale.

summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of rapidly writing a navigational goal attractor in the fly's navigation center through a recurrent circuit of ring-shaped neurons.

insights_en: Novelty: Designing a method for rapidly writing a navigational goal attractor
Method highlight: Using a fly neuron circuit for experiments
Key finding: Neuronal dynamics influence attractor stability
abstract: Recurrent attractor networks are widely thought to form the basis of working memory1–3, but how they can be rapidly switched on and off is unclear4–7. Here we investigate stability and switching in a recurrent circuit of the fly navigation centre8. h∆K and PFG neurons are recurrently connected in a ring structure and exhibit shared persistent bump activity that turns on with odour and terminates at the end of a goal-directed run. Using whole-cell recordings, we show that persistence in h∆K depends on recurrence, and that h∆K receives slow recurrent excitation and fast inhibition from its synaptic partners. Computational modelling reveals that these synaptic dynamics yield persistent attractor dynamics over a range of synaptic strengths. Next we examine the mechanisms of rapid switching. We find that whereas both populations show similar activity during runs, they become decoupled during turns and rest. We can reproduce these differential dynamics in our model by using inhibition to dynamically uncouple activity in h∆K from PFG. When h∆K is inhibited, PFG neurons follow their inputs from the compass system; when h∆K is disinhibited, recurrent interactions lock this input into place, forming a heading memory. Consistent with this model, we find that inhibitory inputs onto h∆K increase during turns and are suppressed during odour and goal-directed runs. Our work reveals how disinhibition can serve as a gate to rapidly write an ongoing measurement to a recurrent circuit. The recurrent h∆K–PFG neural circuit generates persistent heading memories through slow excitation, fast inhibition and a disinhibitory gate, where disinhibition controls the functional coupling of the network to rapidly transition between measurement and memory.

title: Observation of relativistic bond weakening in seaborgium hexacarbonyl
summary_zh: 研究通过实验测量海博格六羰基化合物的键能，揭示超重元素中相对论效应的影响。
summary_en: This study experimentally measures the bond dissociation energy of seaborgium hexacarbonyl, revealing the influence of relativistic effects on superheavy elements.
insights: 创新点：首次测量海博格六羰基化合物的键能
方法亮点：气相色谱法研究金属-配位键稳定性
关键发现：相对论效应对超重元素键能的影响
insights_en: Novelty: First measurement of the bond dissociation energy of seaborgium hexacarbonyl
Method highlight: Gas chromatography study of metal-ligand bond stability
Key finding: The influence of relativistic effects on the bond energy of superheavy elements
abstract: Abstract The seventh row of the periodic table of the elements has been completed with the discovery of the five heaviest elements from flerovium (Fl, Z = 114) through oganesson (Og, Z = 118) 1 . Chemical properties of the superheavy elements (SHE, Z ≥ 104) are unique owing to the strong influence of relativistic effects on their valence electron shells 2 . The stability of the metal–ligand bonding in carbonyl complexes is a property that is predicted to be affected by such effects 3,4 . Here we present an experimental gas chromatography study on the stability of the Sg(CO) 6 complex. The measured formation yields of Sg(CO) 6 and W(CO) 6 enabled determining the first bond dissociation energy (FBDE) of Sg(CO) 6 , which is 4(2) kJ mol −1 lower than that of W(CO) 6 and corresponds to a value of 188(9) kJ mol −1 . Thus, the trend of increasing FBDE values of hexacarbonyls within group 6 of the periodic table is reversed from W to Sg. Our result agrees with state-of-the-art theoretical calculations, which predict a decrease in the FBDE from W(CO) 6 to Sg(CO) 6 owing to the relativistic destabilization of the 6d atomic orbitals (AOs) in Sg (ref. 4 ). Also, the adsorption enthalpy value of Sg(CO) 6 on gold of $${45}_{-6}^{+4}\,{\rm{kJ}}\,{{\rm{mol}}}^{-1}$$ 45 − 6 + 4 kJ mol − 1 is reported.

title: RNA catalysis emerges from dynamic structural ensembles
summary_zh: 研究RNA结构与Mg2+动态互作，揭示活性构象关键作用。采用冷冻电镜数据解析，发现Mg2+在结构、动态和催化中起关键作用。
summary_en: This study investigates the dynamic interaction between RNA structure and Mg2+ ions, revealing the critical role of active conformations. Cryo-EM data analysis reveals that Mg2+ plays a key role in structure, dynamics, and catalysis.
insights: 创新点：揭示RNA催化动态结构的关键作用
方法亮点：冷冻电镜数据解析揭示Mg2+作用
关键发现：Mg2+在结构、动态和催化中起关键作用
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the critical role of dynamic structural ensembles in RNA catalysis
Method highlight: Cryo-EM data analysis reveals the role of Mg2+
Key finding: Mg2+ plays a critical role in structure, dynamics, and catalysis
abstract: Abstract The dynamic interplay between RNA structure and its associated Mg 2+ ions is central to RNA function yet remains poorly understood at a near-atomic level 1–4 . Here, using a heterogeneity-focused protocol for cryo-electron microscopy data analysis of conformationally flexible RNA particles, we determined the structures of RNase P RNA ensembles composed of 76 coexisting active and inactive conformers that differ in a transient tertiary interaction that is critical for activity. The binding of the accessory protein does not change the local structure but induces thermodynamic allostery that enhances catalysis by altering the dynamics of the tertiary interaction. Four distinct classes of Mg 2+ ions have critical roles in the structure, dynamics and catalysis of the conformational ensembles. Together, these findings establish a new paradigm in which catalysis is regulated through multimodal communications coupled with the dynamics of RNA–Mg 2+ conformational ensembles, rather than a single static catalytic structure in a single action mode.

abstract: A fossil of an early ancestor of mammals from the Jurassic period reveals a mammal-like throat passage (pharynx) and throat bones (hyoids). It fills a gap in our knowledge about throat features in the animals from which modern mammals evolved their ability to swallow as adults and suckle milk as babies. A fossil discovery suggests that suckling emerged in a common ancestor of modern mammals that lived in the Jurassic period.

abstract: Semiconductor crystals grow from tiny nuclei, but the position of these nuclei is difficult to control precisely and can affect the crystal’s properties. An approach using ‘etching flux’ has now been developed that constrains the position at which a nucleus forms, enabling spatially programmable growth of large single crystals of semiconducting material. Single crystals of a semiconductor can be formed in a spatially programmable way.

title: 5-oxoETE links redox control of epithelial damage detection and resilience
summary_zh: 研究发现5-oxoETE通过调节NADP+/NADPH比率，在氧化免疫防御和组织适应中起关键作用。
summary_en: The study identifies 5-oxoETE as a key player in redox signaling, regulating oxidative immune defense and tissue adaptation through the NADP+/NADPH ratio.
insights: 创新点：5-oxoETE在氧化免疫防御和组织适应中起关键作用
方法亮点：通过NADP+/NADPH比率调节
关键发现：5-oxoETE在伤口处通过G蛋白偶联受体激活免疫细胞
insights_en: Novelty: 5-oxoETE plays a key role in oxidative immune defense and tissue adaptation
Method highlight: Regulation through the NADP+/NADPH ratio
Key finding: 5-oxoETE activates immune cells at wounds through G-protein-coupled receptors
abstract: Abstract Organisms harness oxidative stress to rapidly attract white blood cells to wound sites and to kill pathogens 1–3 . To this end, host tissues increase their own oxidative stress resilience and repair capacity via adaptive redox signalling 4–6 . Here, using live zebrafish and human cells, we identify a metabolic redox signalling mechanism that integrates oxidative immune defence with tissue adaptation. We demonstrate that DHRS7, an orphan short-chain fatty acid dehydrogenase–reductase, generates or consumes the pro-inflammatory lipid 5-oxoETE as a function of cytoplasmic NADP + /NADPH ratio. At wounds, where oxidative stress and NADP + are high, 5-oxo-eicosatetraenoic acid (5-oxoETE) production by DHRS7 rapidly alerts antimicrobial white blood cells through the G-protein-coupled receptor OXER1. In undamaged tissue, where NADP + is low, DHRS7 quenches unnecessary inflammation. Notably, we find that 5-oxoETE also supports epithelial redox resilience; OXER1-deficient zebrafish exhibit intestinal apoptosis, barrier disruption and microbial inflammation. Mechanistically, 5-oxoETE induces the expression of NUDIX hydrolases, which protect the cytoplasmic nucleotide pool from oxidation and prevent apoptosis in zebrafish and human intestinal cells. Thus, our data reveal a conserved mode of redox sensing and signalling—beyond classic thiol oxidation—that leverages NADPH metabolism to orchestrate the antimicrobial and pro-resilience functions of oxidative stress.

summary_zh: 研究过去20年大西洋近惯性流增强。发现南大西洋和高纬度北大西洋增强，低纬度北大西洋减弱。

方法亮点：使用表面漂流器测量

Method highlight: Use of surface drifter measurements
Key finding: Strengthening in the South Atlantic and high-latitude North Atlantic
abstract: Near-inertial currents (NICs) play a key role in surface material redistribution and ocean mixing, yet their long-term variability remains poorly known. Using in situ current measurements from surface drifters, we provide observational evidence for a pronounced intensification of surface NICs in the Atlantic Ocean over the past two decades (2003–2022). Basin–mean NIC strength increases at a rate of 3.8 ± 1.7% per decade, with a spatial pattern characterized by strengthening in the South Atlantic and the high-latitude North Atlantic, and weakening in the low-latitude North Atlantic. We further show that these trends in Atlantic NICs are primarily driven by changes in near-inertial wind forcing, particularly those associated with mesoscale weather systems, while variations in mixed-layer depth playing a minor role. This observed intensification of Atlantic NICs may have important implications for ocean transport and mixing, and needs to be properly represented in the current generation of climate models. Ocean drifter observations reveal that Atlantic near-inertial currents intensified by almost 4% per decade during 2003–2022. This intensification is primarily driven by changes in wind forcing associated with mesoscale weather systems.

title: Topologically robust programmable processing arrays using light and matter skyrmions
summary_zh: 研究利用光和物质Skyrmions构建拓扑鲁棒可编程处理阵列。提出平台无关架构，克服传统架构限制。
summary_en: This study investigates the construction of topologically robust programmable processing arrays using light and matter skyrmions. It proposes a platform-independent architecture to overcome limitations of conventional architectures.
insights: 创新点：利用Skyrmions构建处理阵列

关键发现：克服传统架构限制
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of processing arrays using skyrmions
Method highlight: Proposal of a platform-independent architecture
Key finding: Overcoming limitations of conventional architectures
abstract: Abstract Photonic computing offers a low-power, high-bandwidth paradigm for information processing; however, the analog nature of conventional architectures means that intrinsic noise and fabrication imperfections greatly impact performance, thereby severely limiting scalability. Recent work on optical skyrmions offers a route to overcoming these limitations by exploiting perturbation-resilient topological invariants of the optical field for computation. Crucially, owing to its relative novelty, an architectural perspective on integrating individual components that manipulate topological charge into a functional system remains an important open challenge. In this paper, we take concrete steps toward system-level design by introducing a platform-independent architecture for skyrmion-based processing, built around a modular library of topologically robust optical primitives, including generators, converters, registers, and adders. This framework enables the synthesis and arithmetic manipulation of topological numbers within a unified programmable architecture. We then experimentally validate this approach using multichannel arrays, demonstrating accurate charge readout and robustness against perturbations in practical optical systems. These results provide a scalable foundation for topologically robust programmable processing arrays, paving the way for compact and integrated photonic processing circuits.

title: Distinguishing learning asymmetry from perseveration in behavioral models
summary_zh: 研究区分行为模型中的学习不对称和坚持。提出统计测试，避免错误检测学习不对称。
summary_en: This study distinguishes learning asymmetry from perseveration in behavioral models. It introduces a statistical test to avoid spuriously detecting learning asymmetries.
insights: 创新点：区分学习不对称和坚持
方法亮点：引入统计测试
关键发现：避免错误检测学习不对称
insights_en: Novelty: Differentiating learning asymmetry from perseveration
Method highlight: Introduction of a statistical test
Key finding: Avoiding spuriously detecting learning asymmetries
abstract: Abstract A central challenge in cognitive science is to distinguish between multiple processes that can result in similar behaviors. In reinforcement learning, one prominent example concerns two potential drivers of choice repetition: a learning asymmetry, in which agents learn differently from outcomes depending on their valence and/or whether they confirm choice, and choice perseveration, an outcome-independent tendency to repeat past choices. Evidence for asymmetric learning has typically relied on computational models that control for perseveration, or specific behavioral markers. Here, we show both these approaches have critical flaws and can spuriously detect learning asymmetries even in perseverative, symmetric-learning agents. To address this, we introduce a statistical test that distinguishes genuine learning asymmetries from spurious effects. Applying this test to a large dataset spanning ten published experiments across four studies, we find that some previously reported confirmation biases are fragile, albeit others remain robust even at an across-study level. Finally, we propose a task design that can yield a more valid qualitative signature of confirmation bias. Our approach provides a reliable framework for disentangling processes underlying choice repetition, while providing tools for the wider research community that can minimize potential spurious effects arising from process mimicry and biased parameter estimation.

title: Cooperative outer-surface recognition extends host–guest chemistry for high-capacity molecular separation beyond cavity inclusion
summary_zh: 研究提出通过激活大环宿主外表面协同作用，超越空腔限域实现高容量分子分离。以葫芦脲(Q[7])为模型，外表面作为识别界面，触发分子招募。Q[7]固定于磁性Fe₃O₄纳米粒子抑制聚集，实现协同。
summary_en: This study proposes extending high-capacity molecular separation beyond cavity confinement by activating cooperative interactions at the outer surfaces of macrocyclic hosts. Using cucurbit[7]uril (Q[7]) as a model, the exposed outer surfaces serve as recognition interfaces, triggering molecular recruitment. Immobilization of Q[7] on magnetic Fe₃O₄ nanoparticles suppresses aggregation and enables synergy.
insights: 创新点：通过外表面协同作用超越空腔限域
方法亮点：葫芦脲(Q[7])作为模型系统
关键发现：外表面作为识别界面触发分子招募
insights_en: Novelty: Overcoming cavity confinement through cooperative outer-surface interactions
Method highlight: Cucurbit[7]uril (Q[7]) as a model system
Key finding: Outer surfaces as recognition interfaces triggering molecular recruitment
abstract: Abstract The separation of azeotropic and structurally similar mixtures remains a fundamental challenge for conventional porous materials. Supramolecular host–guest chemistry provides exceptional recognition precision but is inherently limited by discrete cavity-confined binding. Here, we establish a strategy that extends host–guest recognition beyond cavity inclusion by activating cooperative interactions at the outer surfaces of macrocyclic hosts. Using cucurbit[7]uril (Q[7]) as a model system, we demonstrate that exposed outer surfaces can serve as amplifying recognition interfaces, where initial guest binding triggers subsequent molecular recruitment through cooperative aromatic interactions. Immobilization of Q[7] on magnetic Fe₃O₄ nanoparticles suppresses aggregation and enables synergistic cavity- and outer-surface-mediated recognition. The resulting material achieves highly selective and efficient separation of benzene (Ben) from n -heptane ( n -Hep) with enhanced adsorption capacity and recyclability. This work suggests outer-surface-mediated cooperative recognition as a general paradigm for designing supramolecular separation materials beyond cavity-centric host–guest chemistry.
